topic: Budgeting for hobbies and entertainment releases
hook: Things that make sense: budgeting for your hobbies

plan_reasons.angle: testing general trends posts (25% of posts until there is data)
plan_reasons.topic_area: from the trend: Grand Theft Auto VI release

caption:
Big entertainment releases break records, but they do not have to break your monthly budget. 🎮

With GTA 6 drawing 39 million players as the biggest launch in PlayStation history, hype can easily lead to surprise expenses. Setting up a dedicated sinking fund for your personal hobbies lets you enjoy the things you love without draining your essential savings. 💡

What is one hobby you love setting aside money for each month?
